mapper.select: SELECT id, position_type, current_index, total_score, status, overall_comment, improvement_advice, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM interview_session WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, position_type, current_index, total_score, status, overall_comment, improvement_advice, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM interview_session ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, position_type, current_index, total_score, status, overall_comment, improvement_advice, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM interview_session ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, position_type, current_index, total_score, status, overall_comment, improvement_advice, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM interview_session WHERE position_type = #{direction} OR position_type LIKE CONCAT(#{direction}, ' /%') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_session ( position_type, current_index, total_score, status, overall_comment, improvement_advice, finished_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{positionType}, #{currentIndex}, #{totalScore}, #{status}, #{overallComment}, #{improvementAdvice}, #{finishedAt}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_session SET position_type = #{positionType}, current_index = #{currentIndex}, total_score = #{totalScore}, status = #{status}, overall_comment = #{overallComment}, improvement_advice = #{improvementAdvice}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
